hypothesis: E15's non-identity round-trip excess is caused by using the cached Manny parent action axis in world space. Expressing that axis in mesh-component space only after entering BalanceActive_Standing will preserve the locked pre-intervention policy state and make every actual-action and axis-probe error equal the unchanged per-joint identity residual.
supporting_runtime_evidence: E15 behavior-neutral tracing measured a constant 90-degree component-to-world rotation, exact action/observation bind agreement, unchanged identity residuals up to 35.962549 degrees, and nonzero-input excess up to 106.601652 degrees.
E16 attempt 1 reproduced the baseline exactly and its post-intervention component-axis algebra collapsed actual/probe excess to below 3e-11 degrees.
E16 attempt 1 was invalid only because the override was active during Standing_Preparation and changed the closed-loop first-active policy action before the intended intervention boundary.
competing_explanations: The world-space axis is intentional and the apparent algebraic collapse is not the live causal transform.
Quaternion multiplication direction or another hidden target frame, rather than world/component axis selection, causes the excess.
Even activation at BalanceActive_Standing may occur too early to preserve the evaluator's first-active pre-intervention policy input and decoded canonical action.

single_changed_variable.name: action_conjugation_axis_frame_after_active_standing_entry
single_changed_variable.implementation_scope: development-only runtime-state guard around the existing component-axis override

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The baseline reproduces E15/E16-attempt1 baseline. The experimental arm has exact first-policy input, first-active-standing input, and first-active canonical decoded actions versus baseline; the trace confirms world-axis behavior before BalanceActive_Standing and component-axis behavior at the captured first active target; identity errors remain unchanged within 0.001 degrees; and every decisive actual/probe error differs from its joint identity residual by at most 0.001 degrees.
falsification_observation: With the component-axis mode confirmed effective only in BalanceActive_Standing and all pre-intervention equality gates passing, any decisive identity residual changes beyond 0.001 degrees or any actual/probe residual exceeds 0.001 degrees.
invalidity_conditions: The experimental path is effective in Standing_Preparation, Standing_FullSimulationActivation, or Standing_PolicyBlend.
First-policy input, first-active-standing input, or first-active canonical decoded action differs from baseline before the axis transform is interpreted.
Source commit, binary, model, seed, timestep, pose, perturbation, capture window, protocol, evaluator, or thresholds differ between arms.
The runtime trace does not prove configured and effective axis modes.
test_first_contract: Before changing behavior, add a unit contract proving that the override is ineffective in Standing_Preparation, Standing_FullSimulationActivation, and Standing_PolicyBlend and effective only in BalanceActive_Standing when explicitly configured.
promotion_policy: Do not promote to production or alter neutral-pose behavior in this experiment. Record evidence and stop after the A/B conclusion.
